calculation.expression: -((r_i,t - median_i(r_i,t)) / rolling_std_20(r_i,t)) * I(dispersion_t > rolling_median_252(dispersion) and dispersion_t < dispersion_{t-3})
calculation.description: Fade each instrument's daily return residual to the cross-asset median, volatility-scaled, only when cross-sectional absolute residual dispersion is elevated but declining over three days. The signal is aligned to next-day return and uses no future data.

validation.regime_notes: Conditional observations: 2020-2022 IC 0.036045 / ICIR 0.088797 (175 dates); 2023-2025 IC 0.053486 / ICIR 0.143534 (186 dates); 2026-2031 IC 0.041632 / ICIR 0.129133 (299 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation. Negative multi-day decay indicates this is a short-horizon reversal signal and should not be extrapolated to 3-10 day returns.
